corrections_summary: The eFEL report is mostly accurate. Every version, date, license, requires_python, dependency, wheel, repository, DOI, API signature and default setting I re-derived matched primary sources and live introspection of efel 5.7.34. Two corrections: (1) get_feature_names() returns 182 entries but only 179 unique names ('time', 'voltage' and 'current' are listed twice). (2) set_int_setting, set_double_setting and set_str_setting are deprecated in favour of set_setting, but the report listed them as ordinary public API. One claim is unverifiable: the exact sag numbers on a spiking non-hyperpolarised trace (sag_ratio1 1.0, sag_amplitude 12.0). Independent probes showed trace-dependent results; sag_ratio1 was None in both, while sag_amplitude 0.0 or sag_ratio2 1.0 appeared. Minor precision gaps: five reported uncertainties are now resolved. Tag 5.7.34 is the master HEAD commit. Multi-element stim lists raise an exception. impedance works on scipy 1.18.1 with a DeprecationWarning. The BlueBrain Zenodo concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.593869. Crossref also has a print date of 2026-06-01. The 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-25 window holds nine releases, counting 5.7.26. No claim was found to be false.
additional_findings: get_feature_names() contains duplicates: 182 entries, 179 unique ('time', 'voltage', 'current' twice). Validate and record the feature universe as a set. Source: venv introspection of efel 5.7.34 (https://pypi.org/project/efel/5.7.34/).

set_int_setting, set_double_setting, set_str_setting and set_dependency_file_location are @deprecated in api.py; setThreshold/setDerivativeThreshold point to set_threshold/set_derivative_threshold, which are also deprecated. Use only set_setting/get_settings/reset. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbraininstitute/eFEL/master/efel/api.py

stim_start/stim_end must be lists of exactly one element; a two-element list raises an Exception. Protocols with multiple pulses need a separate trace dict (or window) per analysis window. Source: probe_sag.py; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbraininstitute/eFEL/master/efel/api.py

LICENSE.txt points readers to files named 'COPYING and COPYING.lesser', but COPYING.lesser returns HTTP 404 on master. The LGPL text is in COPYING.less, and COPYING exists (HTTP 200). Record this in LICENSE_AUDIT.md. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbraininstitute/eFEL/master/LICENSE.txt
PyPI metadata declares no SPDX license_expression (null); only the legacy license string 'LGPLv3'. Source: https://pypi.org/pypi/efel/json

The 5.7.34 git tag resolves to commit 3a1652676fc05608f4616a33e874cba049b5a213, the master HEAD, so master-branch docs/source read on 2026-09-13 correspond to the 5.7.34 release. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/openbraininstitute/eFEL/git/ref/tags/5.7.34

macOS wheels for 5.7.34 exist only for arm64 (macosx_11_0_arm64); there are no macOS x86_64 wheels, so Intel Macs would need a C++17 source build. Linux wheels are manylinux_2_24/2_28 for x86_64 and aarch64. Source: https://pypi.org/pypi/efel/json

The impedance feature works on scipy 1.18.1 but emits a DeprecationWarning for the scipy.ndimage.filters import path (installed pyfeatures.py line 153), so it may break on a future scipy. pyproject.toml sets pytest filterwarnings ignore::DeprecationWarning, so upstream tests would not surface it. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbraininstitute/eFEL/master/pyproject.toml, venv probe.

The docs name 'voltage_deflection_stim_ssse' as a required input of sag_amplitude, but it is not an exposed feature name in 5.7.34. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbraininstitute/eFEL/master/docs/source/eFeatures.rst plus membership test.

Window semantics differ across features: spike_count_stimint uses inclusive bounds [stim_start, stim_end], mean_frequency counts spikes strictly inside (stim_start, stim_end), and trace_check tolerates peaks up to 1.05*stim_end. NeuroSem should freeze one analysis-window convention. Sources: eFeatures.rst and installed pyfeatures.py.

The burst warning '4 or more spikes are needed for burst calculation.' is written to process stdout by the C++ core, not raised as a Python warning, so warnings.catch_warnings will not capture it. Capture at file-descriptor level if it must be logged. Source: probe.py (contextlib.redirect_stdout did not capture it).
get_mean_feature_values returns numpy float 0.0 for spike_count on a no-spike trace, and None for undefined features. Source: probe.py.

The BlueBrain-era Zenodo concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.593869 (DataCite, 72 HasVersion relations); 10.5281/zenodo.14222078 is its 5.7.13 version DOI. Version DOIs under the new concept 10.5281/zenodo.19604220 include 10.5281/zenodo.22014994 (5.7.32). Sources: https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.5281/zenodo.593869, https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.5281/zenodo.22014994

Crossref lists published-print 2026-06-01 alongside published-online 2026-05-22 for 10.1093/bioinformatics/btag328. Author names carry diacritics (Anıl Tuncel, Aurélien Jaquier). Use Crossref's forms in CITATION.cff. Source: https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag328

The README copyright footer still reads 2009-2024 Blue Brain Project/EPFL, while LICENSE.txt adds Open Brain Institute 2025-2026 (the 5.7.33 release updated copyright notices).
